name: shopify-reviews-cloudflare-app
description: Cloudflare-native Shopify reviews app with clean GitHub deployment for Workers, D1, R2, Queues and Durable Objects.

scripts.check: node --experimental-strip-types --check src/index.ts && node --check src/core.mjs && node --check scripts/provision.mjs && node --check scripts/cloudflare-build-hook.mjs && node --check scripts/deploy-all.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.mjs

SHOPIFY_API_KEY.description: A normal-text setup placeholder is created automatically. Replace it with the Shopify app client ID. You may change it to Secret to match the sync app deployment pattern.

SHOPIFY_API_SECRET.description: A normal-text setup placeholder is created automatically. Replace it with the Shopify app client secret, change the type to Secret, and deploy.

APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: A normal-text setup placeholder is created automatically. Replace it with a stable random value of at least 32 characters, change the type to Secret, and deploy.

TURNSTILE_SECRET.description: Optional. Add this as a Worker secret only when Cloudflare Turnstile is enabled on the storefront form.
